Title: PathwayDesigner: an interactive SBML/KEGG/Reactome/Escher compatible editor for biochemical network diagrams
Summary: Presents PathwayDesigner, an interactive SBML/KEGG/Reactome/Escher-compatible editor for biochemical network diagrams with Antimony layout and SBML Layout/Render support.

Title: Enzyme-Constrained Metabolic Modeling Reveals CO2-Dependent Growth Control in Picochlorum celeri
Summary: Reconstructs iPiccel954 and enzyme-constrained eciPiccel954 for Picochlorum celeri to explain CO2-dependent growth when enzyme abundance rises only modestly.

Title: Systems Biology and Network Modeling of Lipid Metabolism in Brassica juncea: A Roadmap for Precision Oil Engineering
Summary: Outlines a systems-biology and network-modeling roadmap for engineering lipid metabolism in Brassica juncea toward precision oil-quality improvement.

Title: Sequential active learning incorporating multi-objective optimization for selective bacterial growth
Summary: Presents a machine-learning sequential active-learning framework with multi-objective optimization to design selective media for six phylogenetically diverse bacteria.

Title: Polaris: A toolkit for standardized construction, integration, and quantitative testing in Escherichia coli and Saccharomyces cerevisiae
Summary: Presents Polaris, a toolkit for standardized construct definition, genomic integration, and quantitative testing in Escherichia coli and Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

Title: Biological Pathways for Lignin Valorization
Summary: Reviews biological lignin-valorization pathways and microbial platforms, covering engineered catabolic routes, adaptive laboratory evolution, and AI-assisted strain and pathway design.

Title: Synthetic Biology Strategies for Engineering Microbial Cell Factories toward Efficient p-Coumaric Acid Biosynthesis
Summary: Reviews synthetic-biology strategies for engineering microbial cell factories to produce p-coumaric acid as a sustainable alternative to plant extraction and chemical synthesis.

Title: Synthetic biology–enabled development of bioactive natural product therapeutic leads
Summary: Reviews synthetic-biology routes to bioactive natural-product leads, including hard-to-source compounds, analog generation, and next-generation hosts for improved microbial synthesis.

Title: Metabolic Engineering of Chromosomally Integrated Bacillus licheniformis for the Efficient Biosynthesis of Pseudouridine
Summary: Applies multilevel metabolic engineering in chromosomally integrated Bacillus licheniformis to raise pseudouridine production for mRNA-vaccine applications.

Title: Improving L-homoserine biosynthesis with engineered Escherichia coli via a dual-function quorum sensing regulation system
Summary: Combines systematic metabolic engineering with dual-function quorum-sensing dynamic regulation to raise L-homoserine production in plasmid-free Escherichia coli.

Title: A sensory-to-enzyme framework reveals engineerable aroma modulators in sweet orange
Summary: Builds a sensory-to-enzyme metabolic-engineering framework that links sweet-orange aroma traits to biosynthetic genes and terpenoid pathway design, including yeast pathway optimization.

Title: Polycation-functionalized quantum dots enriched at thylakoid membrane domains enable in situ assembly of a semi-artificial photosynthetic system for broadband light harvesting and metabolic adaptation in synechocystis
Summary: Assembles a semi-artificial photosynthetic system in Synechocystis by enriching polycation-functionalized quantum dots at thylakoid membranes for broadband light harvesting and metabolic adaptation.
